clues.it: Rosa era nella 9ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 9th column, in the 1st row and north of Dario.

clues.it: Marta era nella 8ª colonna, a nord di Dario e in Serra.
clues.en: Marta was in the 8th column, north of Dario and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Vito era nella 6ª colonna, a ovest di Marta e in Serra.
clues.en: Vito was in the 6th column, west of Marta and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Nino era nella 4ª riga, accanto a un'antenna e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Nino was in the 4th row, beside an antenna and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Dario era nella 4ª colonna e su una perdita di refrigerante, ma non era accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Dario was in the 4th column and on a coolant spill, but was not beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Luca era nella 6ª riga, accanto a una consolle e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Luca was in the 6th row, beside a console and west of Rosa.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a un reattore, a nord di Tea e sul Ponte di Comando.
clues.en: Irene was beside a reactor, north of Tea and on the Command Deck.

clues.it: Anna era nella 8ª riga, nella stessa stanza di Sergio e in Mensa.
clues.en: Anna was in the 8th row, in the same room as Sergio and in the Mess Hall.

clues.it: Tea era accanto a una consolle e a ovest di Fabio.
clues.en: Tea was beside a console and west of Fabio.

clues.it: Sergio era in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Sergio was in a different room from Fabio.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era nella 10ª colonna, accanto a un serbatoio e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Olga was in the 10th column, beside a fuel tank and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 13ª riga, ma non era accanto a una perdita di refrigerante.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 13th row, but was not beside a coolant spill.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
